company.shortDescription: Cyble is a leading AI-powered threat intelligence company offering comprehensive coverage of adversaries, exposure, weaknesses, and targets.
company.description:
Cyble provides the fastest and most comprehensive coverage across adversaries, infrastructure, exposure, weaknesses, and targets.

Cyble empowers governments and enterprises to safeguard their citizens and infrastructure by providing critical intelligence in a timely manner and enabling rapid detection, prioritization, and remediation of security threats through its advanced capabilities for data analysis, expert insights, and automated processes

Headquartered in Cupertino, California, with offices in Australia, Malaysia, Singapore, Dubai, Saudi Arabia, and India, Cyble has a global presence. To learn more about Cyble, visit www.cyble.com.

aiResearchSummary.text: Cyble is researching and developing a system and method to identify cyber threat intelligence from a group of information. The disclosed system includes a processing subsystem with a data sourcing module to fetch information and a data processing module to extract textual information. This work focuses on automating the identification and extraction of cyber threat intelligence, aligning with Cyble’s emphasis on AI-powered threat intelligence and comprehensive coverage of adversaries, exposure, weaknesses, and targets.

insights.title: Funding is concentrated in the latest major round
insights.statement: The latest disclosed Series B round raised $6,200,000, or 13.84% of reported total funding.
insights.implication: This round accounts for most reported historical financing, making it important when assessing funding-source concentration and fundraising cadence.

insights.title: Valuation increased across disclosed rounds
insights.statement: Known post-money valuation rose from $925,972 to $170,515,659, a 184.15x increase.
insights.implication: The disclosed financing history indicates a material valuation step-up between the earliest and latest rounds with known valuations.
caveats: Only rounds with a disclosed post-money valuation are compared.

insights.statement: Crunchbase scores growth at 67 (-10 over 90 days) and market heat at 51 (-6).
